name: Anduke di Ares
original_name: アンデューク・ディ・アレス
source:
He calls himself the invincible dirty super hero. He is the only man on earth who is of Elyos descent. Using swords and attack magic, he cuts down his foes one after another. He is a mack to the ladies who has all the techniques. What is he some kind of technician?! The scar on his chest is from when he pulled out the Heavenly Jewel that served as his heart during the demon war 100 years ago.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071215205316fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/da/char01.html]Mink[/url]]
